script.title: THE RIGHT DOG FOOD
script.story_hook: A student finds better food for her itchy puppy.
script.intro_zh: 一位大學生替一直抓癢的小狗找更合適的飼料。
script.welcome_en: Hi again! Today: picking the right dog food.
script.welcome_zh: 又見面了!今天來幫小狗挑對飼料。
script.outro: Sixty lines done — dog food shopping is easy now.
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完了,買狗糧現在很輕鬆。
script.practice_intro_en: Chapter three: say each line with the speaker.
script.practice_intro_zh: 第三章,跟著說話者把每句唸出來。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her early twenties with long straight black hair in a ponytail, wearing a light green sweater, dark jeans and white sneakers, slim build, carrying a canvas tote bag
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged man with short graying hair and round glasses, wearing a blue apron over a plaid shirt, khaki pants and brown work boots, lean tall build, friendly smile

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, my puppy won't stop scratching.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ maɪ ˈpʌpi woʊnt stɑp ˈskrætʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你好,我家小狗一直抓癢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no! How old is your little one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ noʊ haʊ oʊld ɪz jɔr ˈlɪtəl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 噢,真糟糕!牠多大了?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just four months — a golden mix.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst fɔr mʌnθəz ə ˈɡoʊldən mɪks/
dialogue.zh: 才四個月大,是黃金混種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That explains it — did the vet check him?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz ɪt dɪd ðə vɛt tʃɛk hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 難怪!獸醫看過了嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, he said try a different food.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hi sɛd traɪ ə ˈdɪfərənt fud/
dialogue.zh: 看過了,建議換飼料試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. What's he eating right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt wʌts hi ˈitɪŋ raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。牠現在吃哪一款?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cheap store brand — and a huge bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tʃip stɔr brænd ænd ə hjudʒ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 店家自有牌,包裝還超大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's fix both. Is he a picky eater?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts fɪks boʊθ ɪz hi ə ˈpɪki ˈitər/
dialogue.zh: 我們都來改善。牠挑嘴嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very — he leaves half the bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri hi livz hæf ðə boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 超挑,每次都剩一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try this salmon puppy formula here.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðɪs ˈsæmən ˈpʌpi ˈfɔrmjələ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 試試這款鮭魚小狗狗糧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Puppy or adult — what's the difference?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʌpi ɔr əˈdʌlt wʌts ðə ˈdɪfərəns/
dialogue.zh: 幼犬糧和成犬糧差在哪?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Puppy food has more protein for growth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʌpi fud hæz mɔr ˈproʊtin fər ɡroʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 幼犬糧蛋白質更多,幫助發育。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see. Does grain-free help the itching?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si dʌz ɡreɪn fri hɛlp ðə ˈɪtʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 了解。無穀的對抓癢有幫助嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes — it depends on the allergy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ɪt dɪˈpɛndz ɑn ðə ˈælərdʒi/
dialogue.zh: 有時候有,要看對什麼過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The vet said probably a food allergy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə vɛt sɛd ˈprɑbəbli ə fud ˈælərdʒi/
dialogue.zh: 獸醫說可能是食物過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then start simple — one protein only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn stɑrt ˈsɪmpəl wʌn ˈproʊtin ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 那就從單純的開始,一種蛋白質。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this one grain-free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs wʌn ɡreɪn fri/
dialogue.zh: 這款是無穀的嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — peas and lentils, no corn.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs piz ænd ˈlɛntəlz noʊ kɔrn/
dialogue.zh: 是的,豌豆和扁豆,不加玉米。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay… um, can I buy a small bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌm kən aɪ baɪ ə smɔl bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 好……呃,可以買小包的嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We only sell twenty-pound sacks here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈoʊnli sɛl ˈtwɛnti paʊnd sæks hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡只有賣二十磅的大袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty? He'll never finish that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti hɪl ˈnɛvər ˈfɪnɪʃ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 二十磅?他吃不完的啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True — dog food goes stale, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /truː dɔɡ fud ɡoʊz steɪl tuː/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯,飼料也會放壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what can I do today?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt kən aɪ du təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我今天可以怎麼辦?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take sample packs — eight small pouches.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ˈsæmpəl pæks eɪt smɔl ˈpaʊtʃəz/
dialogue.zh: 帶試用包吧,八個小袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Samples? Are they free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsæmpəlz ɑr ðeɪ fri/
dialogue.zh: 試用包?是免費的嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One set per dog — free today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɛt pər dɔɡ fri təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 每隻狗限一組,今天免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great! How long until I know it works?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt haʊ lɔŋ ʌnˈtɪl aɪ noʊ ɪt wərks/
dialogue.zh: 太好了!多久才知道有沒有效?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it four weeks, little by little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt fɔr wiːks ˈlɪtəl baɪ ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢餵滿四週再看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mix the old food with the new?
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪks ði oʊld fud wɪð ðə nuː/
dialogue.zh: 要把舊飼料混新的嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — mostly old, one spoon of new.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈmoʊstli oʊld wʌn spun ʌv nuː/
dialogue.zh: 對,舊的多一點,加一勺新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Oh no — he just ate a pouch!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɑʊ noʊ hi dʒʌst eɪt ə paʊtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好。噢不,他剛剛咬破一袋!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! He approves — that's a good sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ hi əˈpruvz ðæts ə ɡʊd saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 哈!他認可了,這是好兆頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, does he need a new bowl too?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ dʌz hi nid ə nuː boʊl tuː/
dialogue.zh: 那,牠也要換碗嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow-feed bowls help fast eaters.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ fid boʊlz hɛlp fæst ˈitərz/
dialogue.zh: 吃太快,適合用慢食碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He inhales dinner in one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪnˈheɪlz ˈdɪnər ɪn wʌn ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他一分鐘就把晚餐吞光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then grab one — it hangs by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡræb wʌn ɪt hæŋz baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那拿一個吧,就掛在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the bag plus samples?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə bæɡ plʌs ˈsæmpəlz/
dialogue.zh: 飼料加試用包多少錢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty-two, and the pouches cost nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti tuː ænd ðə ˈpaʊtʃəz kɔst ˈnʌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 四十二元,試用包不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that's my whole weekly budget.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðæts maɪ hoʊl ˈwikli ˈbʌdʒɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯,那是我一個禮拜的伙食預算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The store brand is twelve dollars less.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stɔr brænd ɪz twɛlv ˈdɑlərz lɛs/
dialogue.zh: 自有牌會便宜十二塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it as good for his skin?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt æz ɡʊd fər hɪz skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對牠的皮膚一樣好嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same recipe — just a different bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈrɛsəpi dʒʌst ə ˈdɪfərənt bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 一樣的配方,只是外面換個袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll try the cheaper one first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl traɪ ðə ˈtʃipər wʌn fərst/
dialogue.zh: 我先試便宜的那包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wise plan. Got a loyalty card?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪz plæn ɡɑt ə ˈlɔɪəlti kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 明智。您有會員卡嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not yet — can I sign up now?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt kən aɪ saɪn ʌp naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 還沒有,現在能辦嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure — five percent back on every bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr faɪv pərˈsɛnt bæk ɑn ˈɛvri bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 當然,每包回饋百分之五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Um, one more thing — returns?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ʌm wʌn mɔr θɪŋ rɪˈtɜrnz/
dialogue.zh: 辦好了。呃,還有一件事,能退貨嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unopened bags, thirty days, keep receipts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈoʊpənd bæɡz ˈθɜrdi deɪz kip rɪˈsits/
dialogue.zh: 未開封的三十天內可退,收據留好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. He hates closed doors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ hi heɪts kloʊzd dɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 記住了,他最怕關門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me about it — my cat does too.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ɪt maɪ kæt dʌz tuː/
dialogue.zh: 我懂,我家的貓也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Okay, store-brand bag and a slow bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑː oʊˈkeɪ stɔr brænd bæɡ ænd ə sloʊ boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 哈!好,那就自有牌加慢食碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bag, one bowl, and sample pouches.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bæɡ wʌn boʊl ænd ˈsæmpəl ˈpaʊtʃəz/
dialogue.zh: 一包糧、一個碗,還有試用包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the card — what do you need?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə kɑrd wʌt du ju nid/
dialogue.zh: 會員卡呢?需要什麼資料?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just your phone number at the register.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst jɔr foʊn ˈnʌmbər æt ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstər/
dialogue.zh: 在收銀台報電話號碼就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy. Where's the checkout counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈiz i wɛrz ðə ˈtʃɛkaʊt ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 簡單。結帳櫃台在哪裡?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the door — mind the puppy cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə dɔr maɪnd ðə ˈpʌpi kɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 就在門邊,小心小狗推車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've been so helpful. Thank you!
dialogue.phonetic: /juz bɪn soʊ ˈhɛlpfəl θæŋk juː/
dialogue.zh: 您幫了我好多,謝謝!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime — keep him off cheap filler.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪˌtaɪm kip hɪm ɔf tʃip ˈfɪlər/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣,別再讓他吃填充料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. See you in four weeks!
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl duː si ju ɪn fɔr wiːks/
dialogue.zh: 好,四週後再來找您!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye! Give that nose a scratch.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ɡɪv ðæt noʊz ə skrætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 再見!幫他撓撓鼻子。

60句英文聽力練習:在寵物店幫小狗挑對飼料的完整對話!
小狗一直抓癢,該換什麼飼料?幼犬糧和成犬糧差在哪?無穀真的有幫助嗎?這支全英文動畫對話帶你聽懂全流程:描述症狀、參考獸醫建議、比較蛋白質、要試用包、討論退貨與會員回饋,最後挑定一包自有牌飼料和慢食碗。

script.youtube_description_en:
"He'll never finish that!" — a very real problem when pet-store bags are twenty pounds. In this 60-line A2 listening animation, a student asks a clerk for help with her itchy puppy: vet advice, puppy versus adult food, grain-free options, a sample pack, a chewed pouch, a slow-feed bowl, and the store-brand bag that saves twelve dollars. She signs up for a loyalty card and learns the return rules before heading to the register. Listen line by line, then repeat every sentence out loud in the shadowing chapter. No memorizing — just listen often and the phrases stick. Great for A2 learners. Subscribe and tap the bell for a new immersive English listening animation every week!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
